title: "Reading List"
description: "An evolving reading list spanning school attendance, psychology, behavioural addiction, digital health, measurement, and education."
page-layout: full
engine: markdown

```{=html}
<div class="page-header"><h1>Reading List</h1></div>
<p class="reading-intro">An evolving collection of papers shaping how I think — across school attendance and emotionally based school avoidance, but also psychology, behavioural addiction, digital health, measurement, and education systems.</p>
<div class="reading-toolbar" role="search" aria-label="Filter reading list">
  <div class="reading-toolbar-row">
    <div class="reading-search-wrap">
      <label for="reading-search" class="sr-only">Search reading list</label>
      <input id="reading-search" type="search" placeholder="Search titles, authors, notes…" autocomplete="off">
    </div>
    <label class="reading-control">Topic
      <select id="reading-topic"><option value="">All topics</option></select>
    </label>
    <label class="reading-control">Year
      <select id="reading-year"><option value="">All years</option></select>
    </label>
    <label class="reading-control">Sort
      <select id="reading-sort">
        <option value="year-desc">Year (newest)</option>
        <option value="year-asc">Year (oldest)</option>
        <option value="title-asc">Title (A–Z)</option>
        <option value="author-asc">Author (A–Z)</option>
      </select>
    </label>
    <label class="reading-control">Per page
      <select id="reading-size">
        <option value="10">10</option><option value="20" selected>20</option>
        <option value="50">50</option>
      </select>
    </label>
    <button id="reading-clear" class="reading-toolbar-button" type="button" hidden>Clear all</button>
  </div>
  <div id="reading-chips" class="reading-chips" aria-label="Active filters"></div>
  <div class="reading-selection-bar">
    <span id="reading-selection-summary">0 selected</span>
    <span class="reading-selection-actions">
      <button id="reading-select-shown" class="reading-toolbar-button" type="button">Select all shown</button>
      <button id="reading-clear-selection" class="reading-toolbar-button" type="button">Clear selection</button>
      <button id="reading-export-ris" class="reading-toolbar-button" type="button" disabled>Export RIS</button>
      <button id="reading-export-text" class="reading-toolbar-button" type="button" disabled>Export text</button>
    </span>
  </div>
</div>
<p id="reading-status" class="reading-status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
<div id="reading-list">
```

```{=html}
</div>
<p id="reading-no-results" class="reading-status" hidden>No entries match your filters.</p>
<nav id="reading-pagination" class="reading-pagination" aria-label="Reading list pages"></nav>
<script>
(function() {
  const root = document.getElementById('reading-list');
  const entries = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('.reading-entry'));
  const noResults = document.getElementById('reading-no-results');
  const search = document.getElementById('reading-search');
  const topic = document.getElementById('reading-topic');
  const year = document.getElementById('reading-year');
  const sort = document.getElementById('reading-sort');
  const size = document.getElementById('reading-size');
  const clear = document.getElementById('reading-clear');
  const chips = document.getElementById('reading-chips');
  const status = document.getElementById('reading-status');
  const pagination = document.getElementById('reading-pagination');
  const selectionSummary = document.getElementById('reading-selection-summary');
  const selectedKey = 'reading-list-selection-v1';
  let savedSelection = [];
  try { savedSelection = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(selectedKey) || '[]'); }
  catch (error) { savedSelection = []; }
  const selection = new Set(savedSelection);
  const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  const state = {
    q: params.get('q') || '', topic: params.get('topic') || '',
    year: params.get('year') || '', sort: params.get('sort') || 'year-desc',
    size: ['10', '20', '50'].includes(params.get('size')) ? params.get('size') : '20',
    page: Math.max(1, Number(params.get('page')) || 1)
  };
  const metadata = entries.map(el => {
    try { return { el: el, data: JSON.parse(el.dataset.meta || '{}') }; }
    catch (error) { return { el: el, data: {} }; }
  });
  [...selection].forEach(id => {
    if (!metadata.some(item => item.data.id === id)) selection.delete(id);
  });
  persistSelection();
  const topics = [...new Set(metadata.flatMap(item => item.data.tags || []))].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
  const years = [...new Set(metadata.map(item => item.data.year).filter(Boolean))].sort((a, b) => Number(b) - Number(a));
  topics.forEach(value => topic.add(new Option(value, value)));
  years.forEach(value => year.add(new Option(value, value)));
  search.value = state.q; topic.value = state.topic; year.value = state.year;
  sort.value = state.sort; size.value = state.size;

  function persistSelection() {
    localStorage.setItem(selectedKey, JSON.stringify([...selection]));
  }
  function updateUrl() {
    const next = new URLSearchParams();
    if (state.q) next.set('q', state.q);
    if (state.topic) next.set('topic', state.topic);
    if (state.year) next.set('year', state.year);
    if (state.sort !== 'year-desc') next.set('sort', state.sort);
    if (state.size !== '20') next.set('size', state.size);
    if (state.page > 1) next.set('page', String(state.page));
    history.replaceState(null, '', `${location.pathname}${next.toString() ? '?' + next : ''}${location.hash}`);
  }
  function filtered() {
    const query = state.q.toLowerCase();
    return metadata.filter(item => {
      const d = item.data;
      return (!query || (item.el.dataset.search || '').includes(query)) &&
        (!state.topic || (d.tags || []).includes(state.topic)) &&
        (!state.year || d.year === state.year);
    }).sort((a, b) => {
      if (state.sort === 'title-asc') return a.data.sortTitle.localeCompare(b.data.sortTitle);
      if (state.sort === 'author-asc') return a.data.sortAuthor.localeCompare(b.data.sortAuthor);
      return state.sort === 'year-asc' ? a.data.sortYear - b.data.sortYear : b.data.sortYear - a.data.sortYear;
    });
  }
  function setState(changes) {
    Object.assign(state, changes);
    if (changes.q !== undefined || changes.topic !== undefined || changes.year !== undefined ||
        changes.sort !== undefined || changes.size !== undefined) state.page = 1;
    render(); updateUrl();
  }
  function renderChips() {
    chips.innerHTML = '';
    [['q', state.q ? `Search: ${state.q}` : ''], ['topic', state.topic ? `Topic: ${state.topic}` : ''],
     ['year', state.year ? `Year: ${state.year}` : '']].forEach(([key, label]) => {
      if (!label) return;
      const chip = document.createElement('button');
      chip.type = 'button'; chip.className = 'reading-chip'; chip.textContent = `${label} ×`;
      chip.setAttribute('aria-label', `Remove ${label}`);
      chip.onclick = () => setState({[key]: ''});
      chips.appendChild(chip);
    });
    clear.hidden = !(state.q || state.topic || state.year);
  }
  function renderPagination(count, totalPages) {
    pagination.innerHTML = '';
    if (!count) return;
    const add = (label, page, disabled, current) => {
      const button = document.createElement('button');
      button.type = 'button'; button.textContent = label; button.disabled = disabled;
      if (current) button.setAttribute('aria-current', 'page');
      button.onclick = () => { state.page = page; render(); updateUrl(); root.scrollIntoView({block: 'start'}); };
      pagination.appendChild(button);
    };
    add('Previous', state.page - 1, state.page === 1, false);
    for (let p = 1; p <= totalPages; p += 1) add(String(p), p, false, p === state.page);
    add('Next', state.page + 1, state.page === totalPages, false);
  }
  function updateSelectionUi() {
    entries.forEach(el => {
      const box = el.querySelector('.reading-select');
      box.checked = selection.has(el.dataset.id);
    });
    const count = selection.size;
    selectionSummary.textContent = `${count} selected`;
    document.getElementById('reading-export-ris').disabled = count === 0;
    document.getElementById('reading-export-text').disabled = count === 0;
  }
  function render() {
    const results = filtered();
    const pageSize = Number(state.size);
    const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(results.length / pageSize));
    state.page = Math.min(state.page, totalPages);
    const visible = new Set(results.slice((state.page - 1) * pageSize, state.page * pageSize).map(item => item.el));
    entries.forEach(item => item.style.display = visible.has(item) ? '' : 'none');
    noResults.style.display = results.length ? 'none' : '';
    renderChips(); renderPagination(results.length, totalPages); updateSelectionUi();
    status.textContent = `${results.length} ${results.length === 1 ? 'entry' : 'entries'} shown, page ${state.page} of ${totalPages}.`;
  }
  function exportEntries(format) {
    const selected = metadata.filter(item => selection.has(item.data.id)).map(item => item.data);
    const content = format === 'ris' ? selected.map(d => {
      const lines = ['TY  - JOUR'];
      if (d.authors) lines.push(`AU  - ${d.authors}`);
      if (d.title) lines.push(`TI  - ${d.title}`);
      if (d.journal) lines.push(`JO  - ${d.journal}`);
      if (d.year) lines.push(`PY  - ${d.year}`);
      if (d.doi) { lines.push(`DO  - ${d.doi}`, `UR  - https://doi.org/${d.doi}`); }
      if (d.abstract) lines.push(`AB  - ${d.abstract}`);
      lines.push('ER  - '); return lines.join('\r\n');
    }).join('\r\n') : selected.map(d =>
      `${d.title}\n${d.authors}${d.year ? ` (${d.year})` : ''}${d.journal ? `\n${d.journal}` : ''}${d.doi ? `\nhttps://doi.org/${d.doi}` : ''}${d.abstract ? `\n${d.abstract}` : ''}`
    ).join('\n\n');
    const blob = new Blob([content], {type: format === 'ris' ? 'application/x-research-info-systems' : 'text/plain'});
    const link = document.createElement('a'); link.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    link.download = `reading-list-selected.${format === 'ris' ? 'ris' : 'txt'}`; link.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(link.href);
  }
  search.oninput = () => setState({q: search.value.trim()});
  topic.onchange = () => setState({topic: topic.value});
  year.onchange = () => setState({year: year.value});
  sort.onchange = () => setState({sort: sort.value});
  size.onchange = () => setState({size: size.value});
  clear.onclick = () => { search.value = ''; topic.value = ''; year.value = ''; setState({q: '', topic: '', year: ''}); };
  document.getElementById('reading-select-shown').onclick = () => {
    filtered().slice((state.page - 1) * Number(state.size), state.page * Number(state.size))
      .forEach(item => selection.add(item.data.id)); persistSelection(); render();
  };
  document.getElementById('reading-clear-selection').onclick = () => { selection.clear(); persistSelection(); render(); };
  document.getElementById('reading-export-ris').onclick = () => exportEntries('ris');
  document.getElementById('reading-export-text').onclick = () => exportEntries('text');
  entries.forEach(el => el.querySelector('.reading-select').addEventListener('change', event => {
    event.target.checked ? selection.add(el.dataset.id) : selection.delete(el.dataset.id);
    persistSelection(); updateSelectionUi();
    status.textContent = `${selection.size} selected.`;
  }));
  window.addEventListener('popstate', () => location.reload());
  render();
})();
</script>
```
